SELECT p.SEX, AVG(g.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(g.avg_alp_gpt) AS avg_alp_gpt
FROM (
  SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
         AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / l.GPT) AS avg_alp_gpt
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.ID NOT IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` = '-'
      AND ID IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
) AS g
GROUP BY p.SEX
